proposals.name: Gravosk Great Bombard
proposals.entry:
The Great Bombards are the enormous long-range cannon for which Gravoska artillery is infamous. They are immense, heavy and mechanically crude compared with more sophisticated foreign artillery.

A single gun may require dozens of Gravosk to load, aim and operate. They are also extremely durable. Their barrels are massively overbuilt, their mechanisms simple enough to repair in field workshops, and their specialized Thunder-Mead propellants capable of throwing enormous projectiles over extraordinary distances.

Permanent Great Bombards defend important fjords, passes and naval approaches. Smaller—but still enormous—versions accompany siege armies.

Veyran artillery engineers frequently describe the weapons as inefficient. Gravosk gunners consider this an academic disagreement.

posts.name: Gamemaster Only
posts.entry:
Several ancient Great Bombard positions in northern Gravoska face toward the interior of the kingdom. They predate the 99 War.

Their range markings correspond to locations where no current city, fortress or known enemy exists. Their magazines are still stocked.
